Definition: from G4160; a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively):--thing that is made, workmanship.
BiblicalUsage: Poiema is a work, a thing made — God's workmanship. Paul says, We are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, in Ephesians 2:10, and that God's invisible things are clearly seen by the things that are made in Romans 1:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe I am God's workmanship, not my own — made by Him, for the works He prepared beforehand. That is the whole of my worth in one word.
